actual_mesh_advisory_review.source: live OpenRouter review of actual native Docker FEMM mesh
actual_mesh_advisory_review.prompt: Create a new 2D planar DC magnetostatic model. All coordinates and dimensions are in millimeters. Use out-of-plane depth 10 mm. Draw an asymmetric C-shaped steel polygon, vertices in order (-15,-12), (10,-12), (10,-6), (-7,-6), (-7,6), (6,6), (6,12), (-15,12), relative permeability 1000, label (-12,0). Add winding rectangles (-5,-4) to (0,4), label (-2.5,0), +50 turns, and (-22,-4) to (-17,4), label (-19.5,0), -50 turns. Both windings have relative permeability 1 and share a +1 A DC circuit. Use enclosing air rectangle (-40,-30) to (30,30), outer A=0, background label (20,20), and B probe (3,0). Use global mesh size 1 mm. No force extraction is requested.

additional_asymmetric_creation_and_arm_e.prompt:
Create a 2D planar DC magnetic model. All coordinates are in millimeters; out-of-plane depth is 10 mm.

Create an asymmetric C-shaped core using these polygon vertices in order:
(-15,-12), (10,-12), (10,-6), (-7,-6),
(-7,6), (6,6), (6,12), (-15,12).
Use linear relative permeability 1000 and place its label at (-12,0).

Add two rectangular winding cross-sections, both with relative permeability 1:
1. From (-5,-4) to (0,4), label (-2.5,0), +50 turns.
2. From (-22,-4) to (-17,4), label (-19.5,0), -50 turns.
Assign both to the same circuit carrying 1 A DC.

Use an enclosing air rectangle from (-40,-30) to (30,30), with A=0 on its boundary and air label at (20,20).
Use a global mesh size of 1 mm. Measure magnetic flux density at (3,0).

proposal.explanation: The model defines an asymmetric C-core using a polygon and two rectangular windings. All dimensions are in millimeters. The core material is assigned a relative permeability of 1000. The windings share a circuit with 1A current, with turns set to +50 and -50 respectively to create a circulating flux. The outer domain is a rectangle from -40,-30 to 30,30 with A=0 boundary conditions. A probe is placed at (3,0) for flux density measurement.

limitations: Public seeds were used to improve instructions and are not an independent holdout.
Separate stochastic runs retain all failures; earlier failures are not replaced by later passes.
Timeout subtype was not recorded in earlier reports. Two 5-second attempts exhausted in about 10.2 seconds; connection exhaustion was inferred. A later successful probe did not reproduce it.
The final connection allowance is 10 seconds, at most two pre-delivery attempts, within a 25-second logical deadline and 90-second planner deadline. Provider/read/write failures are not replayed.
Native meshing and solving do not establish requested intent or numerical convergence.
Six seeded visual cases and one actual-mesh example are advisory evidence, not an accuracy certification.
Existing explicit model settings override new defaults. Saved credentials/settings and the older service were preserved; no production deployment.
